catalog_description: Computed insider-risk scores per individual, derived from weighted behavioral indicators and updated continuously as new activity arrives.
Platform users referenced as assignees, authors, approvers, and creators across records.
Utility-owned network infrastructure such as substations, transformers, poles, lines, and pipelines, with type, location, capacity, age, and operational status.
Customer utility invoices aggregating meter reads, regulatory adjustments, and payment terms into a billable statement.
Customer-premise accounts in a utility service territory, covering contract, billing profile, meter assignment, and connection status across residential, commercial, and industrial scopes.
Electricity, water, gas, and waste consumption recorded per period for billing and emissions reporting.
Physical meter devices at customer premises (electric, gas, water), with device type, manufacturer, install date, accuracy class, and commissioning state.
Work requests to connect, disconnect, move, or modify service at a premise, with requested date, work type, and fulfillment status.
IRS 409A fair-market-value reports for an issuer, covering methodology, per-class fair value, and valuation date, superseded by later reports.
Structured value propositions mapping a capability to a persona outcome and competitive differentiation.
Delivery performance metrics per repository or product, such as lead time, deployment frequency, mean time to recover, and change failure rate, computed over a window.
End-to-end flows from customer demand to realized value, with lead time, process time, value-add ratio, and waste categorization.
Site-specific application maps authored from yield zones and soil tests, then dispatched to field machinery.
Actual-versus-plan reconciliations by account and period, capturing planned amount, actual amount, variance, and root-cause commentary.
Investment opportunities moving through the deal pipeline, from sourcing and diligence to term sheet and closed or declined.
Driver vehicle inspection reports, pre-trip or post-trip, listing defects, photos, and the driver signature, with defects routing to maintenance.
Parts stocked in garages and service bays for immediate vehicle repair use.
GPS-segmented trip records with start and end times, route trace, distance, duration, idle time, jurisdictions, and driver.
Maintenance and repair work orders for fleet vehicles, with task lines for labor and parts, assigned mechanic and shop, and a status lifecycle.
Pre-payment approvals for vendor-direct payments, distinct from employee-initiated spend requests.
Certificates of insurance on file for a vessel, with insurer, policy number, liability limits, and expiry, as required by slip and storage contracts.
Verified vessel registration records, with registration number, jurisdiction, and expiry.
Boats on file at the marina, with name, type, dimensions, hull identification, and owning boater.
Vesting cadences for equity grants, covering cliff, vesting frequency, total months, and acceleration logic.
Structured lab results for animal patients, with tests, values, reference ranges, ordering vet, and reporting lab.
Vaccination records for animal patients, with vaccine type, lot, administered date, expiry, and next-due date for reminders.
Chatbot and virtual-agent conversation transcripts, capturing the turn-by-turn exchange, resolved intent, any escalation to a human, and the ticket produced.
Links to external video meetings for a virtual session, carrying the join URL and recording reference.
Timestamped audit trail of visitor state transitions such as registration, check-in, badging, and check-out, for compliance.
Physical or digital badges issued at check-in, encoding visitor identity, host assignment, access scope, and expiration.
Visitor arrival events at facility entry, with credential verification and a badge-issuance trigger.
Real-time rosters of visitors on-site, correlated with spaces and emergency zones for evacuation and accountability.
Signed or electronically acknowledged non-disclosure agreements captured per visit as a legal-hold artifact.
Pre-visit registrations stating arrival intent, expected access duration, host assignment, and pre-screening, initiating the visitor lifecycle.
Screening results checking visitors against external watchlists such as sanctions, banned-visitor, and threat databases, held for compliance.
Voluntary candidate disclosures of protected-class membership per EEOC and OFCCP requirements, recording the offer or decline-to-answer decision and audit metadata.
Specific weaknesses detected on specific assets, deduplicated across scans and tracked from open to closed, with severity, computed risk, and ownership.
Scoped, point-in-time assessments or remediation campaigns over an asset population, grouping vulnerabilities into a posture snapshot with scope, window, and summary.
Reference catalog of known vulnerabilities (identifiers, advisories, affected products, base severity, references) that scan findings are matched against and enriched from.
Governed, time-boxed risk acceptances, deferrals, or false-positive designations for vulnerabilities not remediated now, with justification, scope, and an expiry that drives re-review.
Remediation work that resolves vulnerabilities, with owning team, due date, SLA, patch or configuration guidance, and verification status.
Scan jobs run against an asset population using a policy or template, progressing through queued, running, and completed, and emitting findings.
Capacity overflow queue for a course offering, with priority order and a notify-on-seat-open policy.
Walk-up or onsite check-in records, capturing the visitor, reason, queue position, estimated service time, and outcome.
Per-distribution waterfall computations, covering hurdle test, catchup, general-partner carry, and limited-partner returns under the fund's distribution agreement.
Per-page tracking records across web properties, with URL, status, last-modified, owner, publish date, review cadence, and lifecycle stage.
Personalized web experiences or landing pages served to named accounts.
URL-routable pages composed from content components for a served digital channel.
Rules mapping a resolved account or segment to a personalized web experience or variant.
Person- or account-level de-anonymizations of web visitors, PII-bearing and consent-gated.
Event subscriptions defining the source system, event type, target recipe, retry policy, and filter logic.
Email, video, push, or SMS messages sent to a new hire during onboarding, with channel, template, scheduled send time, delivery state, and engagement metrics.
B2B orders from chef, restaurant, co-op, or food-hub buyers, with per-line pricing tiers, packing-list reference, and net-30 invoicing.
Structured interviews with won or lost buyers capturing decision drivers, interviewee identity, and quotes.
Banking fund-transfer instructions, with originating and destination accounts, amount, currency, beneficiary, purpose code, compliance flags, and execution status.
Ordered or parallel sets of approval steps that gate a work item or project transition.
Single approval gates on a work item or project, performed by a designated approver, with states pending, approved, rejected, or expired.
Trigger-action rules defined per board or project, with triggers like status change or assignment driving multi-step conditional actions.
Per-work-item values for a custom field, one value per item and field.
User-defined fields attached to a project or workspace, typed as text, number, date, select, and more, applying to all items in scope.
Saved, shareable cross-project dashboards composed of widgets that summarize work progress, workload, and goal status.
Typed dependencies between two work items, linking predecessor and successor with finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish, or start-to-finish type.
Right-to-work evidence for a worker such as a visa or work permit, effective-dated with a tracked expiry, jurisdiction-conditional and access-restricted.
Submitted instances of an intake form, carrying field values, submitter, and timestamp, and converting to a work item via routing rules.
Structured intake form definitions, with field schema, validation, target project, and routing rules.
Contribution links between a work item or project and an objective, so goal progress can roll up from the work that drives it.
Operator-facing step sequences for building or assembling a product variant, with resource requirements, quality checkpoints, safety notes, and attached media.
Files or external links attached to a work item.
Threaded comments on a work item, which may include personal or sensitive content.
Assignments linking work items to tags, where existence asserts the tag is applied.
The atomic task, item, or card in a work-management platform, with owner, due date, status, priority, dependencies, subtasks, attachments, and comments.
Zero-duration gates within a project marking a meaningful transition, distinguished from regular items by passed or missed semantics.
Audit fieldwork documentation, recording test procedures executed, evidence gathered, conclusions, and sign-off, keyed to audit programs and control tests.
Team-level groupings of related projects for cross-project status roll-up.
Reusable project blueprints with seeded sections, items, custom fields, and automations.
Containers of work items (project, board, sheet, or space), with timeline, status, owner, members, dashboards, and embedded views.
Published shift schedules for a department, location, and week, derived from labor-demand forecasts and worker-availability constraints.
Containers within a project that group work items for board and list views.
Scheduled work blocks assigned to a worker, with start, end, position, location, break plan, and premium pay flags.
Logged status-change events on a work item or project, capturing the prior status, new status, who changed it, and when.
Configurable status values in a project or team status taxonomy, with category (not started, in progress, done) and display order.
Free-form labels attached to work items for cross-cutting categorization such as priority, theme, or status.
Reusable work-item blueprints with seeded assignee role, due-date offset, subtasks, and custom field defaults.
Non-billable time logged against a work item for effort tracking and capacity reporting.
Per-user, per-period sums of allocated effort across work items, compared against a capacity ceiling.
Saved, named, shareable board, list, timeline, or calendar views of work items, with persisted filters, grouping, and sort.
Home, work, and mailing addresses for a worker, effective-dated and typed by purpose, supporting multi-jurisdiction formats.
Self-service requests by an employee or manager to change worker data, routed through approval before committing to the worker record.
Fully-loaded workforce cost forecasts per period by org unit, role, location, and level, built from headcount, compensation bands, and loading factors.
Multi-year strategic workforce plans covering target headcount, skills, location, and cost, with planning horizon, base assumptions, and approval state.
What-if models layered on a base workforce plan, each with a type, perturbation parameters, and the modeled outcome on headcount, skills, and cost.
Named workforce cohort definitions used for analysis and intervention, such as high-potential, flight-risk, top-performer, and early-career.
Employee survey feedback on office experience, covering comfort, amenities, and satisfaction, informing workplace strategy.
Employee requests for workspace changes such as desk relocation, accommodation needs, or floor reassignment, routed to facilities.
Experience-API event log entries capturing actor-verb-object learning activity inside or outside the learning system.
